payload.prompt: L'un de vos clients a une facture en retard. Trouvez la facture en retard et enregistrez des frais de rappel de 70 NOK. Debit creances clients (1500), credit revenus de rappel (3400). Créez également une facture pour les frais de rappel au client et envoyez-la. De plus, enregistrez un paiement partiel de 5000 NOK sur la facture en retard.

payload.goal: Find the overdue customer invoice, add reminder fee accounting entries (debit 1500, credit 3400) for 70 NOK, create and send a reminder-fee invoice to the same customer, and register a partial payment of 5000 NOK on the overdue invoice.
success_checks: An overdue customer invoice is identified
A voucher or accounting entry exists with debit account 1500 = 70 NOK and credit account 3400 = 70 NOK
A new customer invoice for 70 NOK reminder fee is created for the same customer
The reminder-fee invoice is marked as sent
A payment of 5000 NOK is registered against the overdue invoice
Outstanding balance on the overdue invoice is reduced by 5000 NOK
risk_notes: No customer name or invoice number provided; overdue invoice selection may be ambiguous if multiple invoices are overdue
Sandbox is empty, so no actual overdue invoice may exist; prerequisite customer/order/invoice bootstrap may be required
Reminder fee may need a product/article or free-text invoice line depending on API constraints
Sending invoice requires valid customer delivery details such as email or e-invoice settings, not provided
Payment registration may require payment date, bank account, and payment method, not provided
Task spans invoice update, voucher creation, invoice creation, sending, and payment registration; multiple APIs may be needed
payload.suggested_first_action: Search customer invoices for overdue status and identify the target overdue invoice; if none exists in sandbox, bootstrap customer, order, and overdue invoice first.
ordered_steps: GET /bank/accounts or equivalent to verify a bank account/payment account exists; create/setup one if required by sandbox before payment registration
GET /invoices?status=OVERDUE or equivalent search to find overdue customer invoices

If no overdue invoice exists in empty sandbox: POST /customer to create customer, POST /order to create order, POST /order/{id}/lines to add original sale lines, POST /order/{id}/invoice to create invoice, then set/choose dates so invoice becomes overdue
Select the target overdue invoice; capture invoiceId and customerId
POST /vouchers or equivalent manual journal endpoint to book reminder fee: debit 1500 = 70 NOK, credit 3400 = 70 NOK, linked to customer/invoice if supported
POST /orders to create a new order for the same customer for reminder fee
POST /order/{id}/lines with description 'Frais de rappel', quantity 1, unit price 70, VAT as configured/confirmed
POST /order/{id}/invoice to create the reminder-fee invoice
POST /invoice/{id}/send or equivalent send action for the reminder-fee invoice
POST /payments or /invoice/{invoiceId}/payments to register partial payment of 5000 NOK on the overdue invoice
GET /invoice/{invoiceId} to verify remaining balance decreased by 5000 NOK and payment is posted
GET /invoice/{reminderInvoiceId} to verify reminder-fee invoice exists and is sent

planned_endpoints.summary: Find invoices corresponding with sent data. Includes charged outgoing invoices only.
Create customer. Related customer addresses may also be created.

rules: ALWAYS include invoiceDateFrom and invoiceDateTo as query params — they cannot be null.
When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
Do NOT send isCustomer (it's readOnly and auto-set).
For addresses, use postalAddress={addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161}} for Norway.
